_about: Thai words that ICU line breaking splits inside a word or that derail the words after them (loanwords and medical terms ICU's dictionary lacks). scripts/build_i18n.mjs keeps each on one line (U+2060) and separates it from neighbouring Thai letters (U+200B). Candidates come from scripts/thai_keep_words.py (PyThaiNLP dictionary + Intl.Segmenter); the list is curated by hand: common words and PyThaiNLP mis-splits are left out.
